svg.aria-label: FinTech Ledger service CI/CD pipeline: GitHub Actions DevSecOps CI to Amazon ECR, then GitOps CD with Argo CD to Amazon EKS
svg.text: Java 17 · Spring Boot · GitHub Actions DevSecOps CI → Amazon ECR → GitOps CD with Argo CD on Amazon EKS
shift-left security: secrets → deps → code → image
gate: blocks the build on failure
ECRURL · REPO · IMAGE tag · TEST env
Amazon EKS · one namespace per environment
auto-sync · self-heal · prune · rollback = git revert
Push → scan → build → push to ECR → dispatch → commit to Git → Argo CD syncs to EKS · no kubectl by hand, every change is in Git
